title: Vacuum Pumps and Evacuation
osha_standards: OSH Act Section 5(a)(1) General Duty Clause
summary: Vacuum Pumps and Evacuation matters because an improperly evacuated system risks moisture and non-condensables remaining in the circuit, and vacuum pump handling has its own hazards.
talking_points: Confirm the system is fully depressurized before connecting the vacuum pump.
Run the pump in a ventilated area.
Check oil level and condition before use.
Confirm zero pressure before connecting evacuation equipment.
Never connect a vacuum pump to a pressurized system.
Never leave a running pump unattended in an unventilated space.
Change pump oil regularly per manufacturer guidance.
If something goes wrong: switch off and isolate the pump if a fault develops; ventilate the area if fumes build up; report any electrical fault immediately.
site_hazards_to_check: Oil mist/fumes from the pump exhaust
Residual pressure in the system before connecting
